description: This file defines a UI component called 'RecipeGrid' using the LightningJS framework. It manages displaying recipe cards in a grid layout, handling selection and navigation.

classes.name: RecipeGrid
classes.description: A LightningJS component for rendering a grid of recipe cards with navigation support.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of recipe items to display and resets the selection index.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Updates the selected index based on directional input (left, right, up, down), within grid bounds.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Emits a 'select' event with the ID of the currently selected recipe item.
